description: What to monitor and why. If a term isn't here, signals about it are noise. Edit this to change what the system pays attention to.

columns.name: term
columns.note: Company, keyword, regulation, technology, event, or — for Newsletter and Feed kinds — the publication's name.

columns.name: kind
columns.note: Newsletter and Feed are SOURCES rather than subjects — they get swept for anything touching the other watch terms, instead of being searched for by name.

columns.name: why
columns.note: What you'd do differently if this moved. A watch item with no answer here is a news habit, not a sales tool.

columns.name: linked_account
columns.note: Account name if this watch exists because of a specific customer or deal

columns.name: linked_id
columns.note: CUST-/OPP-/LEAD- id if tied to a tracked record

columns.name: sources
columns.note: Where to look. For Newsletter entries put the sender address (e.g. news@example.com); for Feed entries the site or RSS URL; for everything else specific sites worth checking. Semicolon-separated. Blank = general search.

columns.name: discovered_how
columns.note: How this entry got here. Inbox-scan entries are guesses and deserve a confirmation pass.
